# Lavendar Lewis

- **Age:** presumed 45  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P34](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0034), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v3 ch.People P3](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P30](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0030)</sub>

## Appearance

Lavendar Lewis is a sweet and pretty lady with a girlish face featuring pink cheeks, dimples, sweet lips, and big, soft brown eyes. She has pretty hands and thick, beautifully wavy snow-white hair that is carefully arranged in becoming puffs and coils.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P25](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0025), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P34](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0034), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), [v3 ch.People P3](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0003)_

## Personality

Lavendar Lewis relies heavily on her imagination to cope with life's difficulties. She frequently copes by engaging in make-believe.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057)_

## Traits

- imaginative  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057)</sub>

## History

Miss Lavendar Lewis lived at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) alongside her young helper, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md). After [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) accidentally discovered her home during a walk, Miss Lavendar hosted them for tea and heard mention of [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), the son of her former fiancé, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). Following a later visit where she recounted her past romance and quarrel with [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Miss Lavendar met [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) and formed a fond friendship with him. Months later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivered a note to Miss Lavendar from [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md), prompting a meeting at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) where Miss Lavendar and [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) reconciled. The pair were subsequently married in an intimate ceremony in her garden. In later years, Miss Lavendar hosted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) during summer vacations, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) confided in her about refusing [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's marriage proposal.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P71](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0071), +21 more_

## Background by volume

**Volume 2**

- formerly engaged to Stephen Irving when they were young  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036)</sub>
- hired little Charlotta Bowman for board and clothes after her mother died ten years earlier  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- presumed jilted by Stephen Irving according to local gossip  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>
- named Lavendar by her father because he loved the scent  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086)</sub>
- suffered a broken heart when Stephen Irving did not return after their quarrel  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)</sub>

**Volume 3**

- lived at Echo Lodge before her marriage  <sub>[v3 ch.Again P58](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0058)</sub>

## Quotes

> "But oh, won’t you stay and have tea with me? Please, do. Mr. Kimball’s will have tea over before you get there. And Charlotta the Fourth and I will be so glad to have you."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)

> "to believe I’m old. Now, who are you . . . just for convenience’ sake? Diana Barry? And Anne Shirley? May I pretend that I’ve known you for a hundred years and call you Anne and Diana right away?"
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062)

> "I love them myself. They are very good company . . . with a little pretending. On calm evenings Charlotta the Fourth and I often sit out here and amuse ourselves with them. Charlotta, take back the horn and hang it carefully in its place."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P74](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0074)

> "It gave me a shock to hear about Stephen’s son that first day you were here, Anne. I’ve never been able to mention him to you since, but I’ve wanted to know all about him. What sort of a boy is he?"
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P21](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0021)

> "Oh, I’m not so old as I thought . . . and I don’t need a single blue pill! Girls, when you come back with your strawberries we’ll have tea out here under the silver poplar. I’ll have it all ready for you with home-grown cream."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P36](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0036)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--lavendar-lewis.md)

[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Miss Lavendar Lewis became close friends after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) lost her way in the woods and discovered [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) regularly visited Miss Lavendar, listening to her past stories and introducing her to [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). Over time, Miss Lavendar confided personal feelings to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), including her past romance and her feelings about marriage proposals.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +14 more_

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--paul-irving.md)

[Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and Miss Lavendar instantly bonded over their mutual love for imaginary dream-people after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) introduced them. Following her marriage to his father, Miss Lavendar became Paul's stepmother, and he affectionately refers to her as Mother Lavendar.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P1](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0001), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P31](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0031), +6 more_
